name: MoEngage
description: MoEngage provides customer profiles, events, devices, campaigns, push, email, SMS, WhatsApp, cards, analytics, and data APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned workspace ID, dedicated Data API key, enumerated data center, and staging health customer. Relay pins two exact-user operations, both approval-gated: export one exact customer profile or update bounded non-consent attributes for one authorized customer.

credentialRequirements.name: MOENGAGE_WORKSPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: MoEngage workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the workspace ID associated with the dedicated Data API key.

credentialRequirements.name: MOENGAGE_DATA_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: MoEngage Data API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned key for User API and support-enabled Get User access only.

credentialRequirements.name: MOENGAGE_DATA_CENTER
credentialRequirements.label: MoEngage data center
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the workspace REST data center, 01 through 06.

credentialRequirements.name: MOENGAGE_HEALTH_CUSTOMER_ID
credentialRequirements.label: MoEngage health customer ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use one dedicated non-production customer for connection health checks.

capabilities.label: Read user
capabilities.description: Export one exact customer profile with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage one user
capabilities.description: Update bounded non-consent attributes for one authorized user with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Manage MoEngage user
approvalRequired.description: Update bounded non-consent attributes for one authorized user.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Workspace IDs, API keys, Basic authorization, health customer IDs, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk transfers
blocked.description: Bulk import, user collections, segments, exports beyond one exact user, and mass data movement are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer campaigns
blocked.description: Events, devices, user merge/delete, campaigns, push, email, SMS, WhatsApp, cards, content, and consent/subscription changes remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only two pinned Data/Get User routes run on enumerated DC-01 through DC-06 origins; arbitrary paths, data centers, queries, headers, attributes, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected operation requires approval; one-user writes additionally require user authorization, while consent/subscription attributes and all bulk/send/admin APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Both selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; user authorization, fixed data-center routing, field/response bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin/consent blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts two pinned exact-user MoEngage routes on enumerated data-center origins with Basic credentials kept server-side.
Railway mounts two pinned exact-user MoEngage routes on enumerated data-center origins with Basic credentials kept server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: MoEngage requires a customer-owned workspace, dedicated Data API key, support-enabled Get User API, data center, and staging health customer. No console, API key, support request, user, attributes, consent, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated staging Data API key and health customer outside this worker, ask MoEngage to enable Get User if necessary, configure the workspace ID/key/data center/health customer in Railway staging, and verify exact-user reads, approval and user-authorization denial/allow, consent-attribute blocking, response bounds, key rotation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: MoEngage's official Postman collection documents the User API path, workspace query/path binding, Basic workspace/API-key authentication, user payload, and separate bulk/event/device APIs.
MoEngage's official collection documents the support-enabled exact-user export path, identifiers payload, and personal-profile sensitivity.
MoEngage documents exact REST origins for DC-01 through DC-06 and requires requests to use the workspace data center.
MoEngage documents workspace-bound API keys, separate key purposes, rotation behavior, and early-access multi-key controls.
